THE LADDER: k in {1, 2, 4, 7} TAVIREN-keyed tokens re-keyed into the ZEPHYRA-keyed stream at matched steps (s25/s125/s300 reads captured; the re-keying positions spread per a pre-registered scheme — disclose exactly which windows flip at each k). THRESHOLD (a sharp step, binomial-like, between k=2 and k=7) / GRADED (dose-like) / NON-MONOTONE (inoculation-shaped — small k PROTECTS). 2. EXECUTES (generic competition — the interference reading wins, the name-key contrast re-words to maintained-vs-not) / NON-EXECUTES (name-pair-specific receptivity — x23's structure revives). 3. THE NEUTRAL-KEY CONTROL (the critic's named control, cheapest arm): a never-seen 7-char bank name key (name-blind draw/mask parity — disclose the name and its priors) on the TAVIREN subject: read still executes = generic competition; read survives = ZEPHYRA-specific slot interference. 4. registered.parity_verbatim: THE PARITY STANDARD (R82/dispatch): birth prints the lab lean AND the counter side by side (T335's P-T335a carries the lab's: SHARP threshold + ZxT EXECUTES, weakly; the counter: GRADED + ZxT NON-EXECUTING — the lab's knives have twice turned out to be patches, and x23's cross-name receptivity structure is the standing counter). P-T335a (THINKING.md, T335, verbatim): 'the read-execution threshold in k (tokens re-keyed) is SHARP — a binomial-like step between k=2 and k=7 (if the key is all-or-nothing, the curriculum's name-content gates as a unit) — and the ZxT symmetry arm EXECUTES (guest-on-ZEPHYRA kills p(Z) as guest-on-TAVIREN killed p(T): generic competition, not receptivity); COUNTER: a graded k-curve (dose-like) and ZxT NON-EXECUTING (name-pair-specific receptivity — x23's cross-name structure revives). The lab lean: sharp + executes, weakly (the 7-token knife looked binary at e345; interference is the cheaper mechanism); the counter, stated plainly: the lab's knifes have twice turned out to be patches (x50, x52's own dip), and the receptivity map's cross-name findings (x23) are the standing counter-structure.'

P_e346a.ladder_guess: GRADED (AGAINST the lab lean's SHARP/THRESHOLD — the counter column's fourth contest)
P_e346a.grounds: LADDER=GRADED: (1) the cold-AdamW s1 displacement is key-blind in MAGNITUDE (e345: |W| 11.52 vs 11.40 at s25) but the host read's s1 fate was already key-directional (0.2859 -> 0.0068 under Z vs -> 0.7490 under T, x52's dense rider_s1): with k-of-16 windows pointing T-ward, the name-gradient at the read's coordinates is a weighted mix scaling with k — a count-proportional dose (e179/e281), graded by construction; no unit-gating mechanism is on the record. (2) even k=16 holds the host only at min-over-three = 0.3090 (the committed s125 dip; dense floor 0.2958): a margin this thin should be landed-inside by intermediate doses (MID), the GRADED signature. (3) the knife's binary look was an ENDPOINT contrast (k=0 vs k=16); the only interior evidence (x52's dense anneal) is an oscillation, not a step. ZxT=EXECUTES: an all-T stream carries zero Z-maintenance windows and the s1 shock is committed-class — the host can only die; no mechanism on the record lets a GUEST stream maintain a foreign host read (x23's counter-structure predicts receptivity asymmetries in formation, not maintenance). NEUTRAL=EXECUTES: same mechanics; SURVIVES requires the Z key to be an ACTIVE executioner (slot interference), which the name-blind write at matched |W| argues against — weakness disclosed: the lab's knives have twice been patches (x50, x52); the SURVIVES branch is the registered surprise.
